payload.text: hv, 1 Nov, first-hand in devbin-vc's window at 11:16Z by devbin-vc's date -u, relayed by devbin-vc and received by vc's date -u of 11:20Z: "IT IS NO USE DOING ANY OF THIS OTHER WORK UNTIL DEVBIN IS SHIPPED. Why are we doing work on other builds (which takes AGES) when the whole point was to get devbin fixed and up and running efficiently SO THAT THE OTHER BUILDS HAPPEN MORE QUICKLY?" Effect, by devbin-vc: rhadamanth's desk grants devbin's ST0011 runs and nothing else until Devbin 0.1.19 is cut and swept into the fleet, and refuses every other ask. Utilz is parked: no run, no desk ask, no push, nothing for hv; vc, cc and dc hold, and a compact's pickup on vc's chain is the only write. It releases on devbin-vc's word that the sweep has reached Utilz; ST0031's order then is its design's, every run booked at the desk. Then hv, in devbin-vc's window at 11:24Z by its date -u, relayed by devbin-vc: "Tell everyone else to localfold+compact, too. And then hold. I'll run compacts in each one." and "The only reason to move any of the other projects is because we need to do something specific to get this devbin release made. Other than that, they stay still for now." So vc, cc and dc localfold for hv's compacts, with no release, then stay still: Utilz moves only for something specific that devbin-vc names this devbin release needs. Peers read this decision at pickup; cc and dc record no copy.
